<!-- generated by packaging/cli_reference.py from `netpulse config --help`; do not edit -->

```text
netpulse config [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>
```

| Subcommand | What it does |
|---|---|
| `path` | Which config file is used, and where NetPulse looks |
| `show` | Show the effective configuration (never the token) |
| `init` | Write a commented netpulse.toml template |
| `check` | Check config, token, storage, the AI service and live capture |

Also accepts the [global options](index.md#global-options) `--config <FILE>` and `--json`.
